backend/main.mo: Main backend canister handling user profiles and booking requests with access control and CRUD-style query and update methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented frontend files, related components, and test IDs for two image-related UI features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of short summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining theme variables, light/dark modes, and base background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, parent portal, and tour booking, wrapped in the AppShell layout.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Main layout component providing navigation, header, footer, and the handprints background around routed content.
frontend/src/components/AuthPanel.tsx: Sign‑in panel using Internet Identity with decorative visuals and a BubbleCard layout for the login experience.
Interactive calendar component allowing date and time selection with month navigation and disabled past dates.
frontend/src/components/BookingConfirmat: Displays a confirmation modal showing booking details, date, optional notes, and booking ID.
frontend/src/components/BubbleCard.tsx: Reusable styled card wrapper providing size-based bubble container classes.
frontend/src/components/MeetAuntieMaiaPa: Profile panel introducing Auntie Maia with image, experience highlights, and a quote.
frontend/src/components/NannyCamFrame.ts: Shows a video iframe if available, otherwise displays a placeholder for an upcoming nanny cam feed.
Renders decorative sticker images (stars or butterflies) in various sizes.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wrapper that shows a loader or auth panel until an Internet Identity is ready, then renders children.
frontend/src/components/StatusWidgets.ts: Displays nap, snack, and play status widgets using BubbleCards with icons and optional timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingRequests.ts: Provides mutations for creating bookings and a query for listing all bookings via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, loading, login, logout, and state management with AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useParentPortalStatus: Fetches parent portal status with placeholder data for nanny cam and activity updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Query hook for retrieving the current user's profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables for light/dark modes, global styles, and utility classes including a repeating handprints background.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/ClubhouseHomePage.tsx: Renders the homepage with hero imagery, animated decorations, and feature highlights for the childcare service.
frontend/src/pages/ParentPortalPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated parent portal showing status widgets and a live nanny cam feed.
frontend/src/pages/ToursInterviewsBookin: Implements the tour and interview booking flow with a calendar, details form, and animated decorations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hashes, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom fonts, OKLCH color tokens, animations, and extended theme utilities.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature requirements, and image-processing tasks for updating hero and background assets.
